56	function parseArgs(values) {

62	    }

64	    const equals = withoutPrefix.indexOf("=");
65	    if (equals !== -1) {

293	function verifyManifest(localArgs = args) {

302	  const manifestMap = new Map(manifest.artifacts.map((artifact) => [artifact.name, artifact]));
303	  const entries = releaseFiles(dir, { includeChecksums: true, includeManifest: false });
304	  const relativeByName = new Map(entries.map((entry) => [entry.name, entry.relative]));
305	  for (const entry of entries) {
306	    if (!manifestMap.has(entry.name)) {
307	      throw new Error(`release-manifest.json is missing ${entry.name}`);
308	    }
309	  }
310	  for (const [name, artifact] of manifestMap) {
311	    const relative = relativeByName.get(name);
312	    if (relative === undefined) {
313	      throw new Error(`manifest entry has no file: ${name}`);
314	    }
315	    const file = path.join(dir, relative);
316	    const digest = sha256(file);
317	    if (artifact.sha256 !== digest) {
318	      throw new Error(`manifest sha mismatch for ${name}`);
319	    }
320	    const bytes = fs.statSync(file).size;
321	    if (artifact.bytes !== bytes) {
322	      throw new Error(`manifest byte count mismatch for ${name}`);
323	    }
324	    assertInstallableArchiveLayout(name, file);
325	  }
326	  for (const [name, digest] of checksumMap) {

338	// The cargo-dist shell installer resolves binaries through the archive's
339	// top-level directory name; "./"-prefixed members (from `tar -C dir .`)
340	// break it with mv ENOENT. rc.7 shipped that breakage from the macOS
341	// signing repack — fail closed if it ever reappears.
342	function assertInstallableArchiveLayout(name, file) {
343	  if (!(name.endsWith(".tar.xz") || name.endsWith(".tar.gz") || name.endsWith(".tgz"))) {
344	    return;
345	  }
346	  const listing = spawnSync("tar", ["-tf", file], { encoding: "utf8" });
347	  if (listing.status !== 0) {
348	    throw new Error(`tar -tf failed for ${name}: ${listing.stderr}`);
349	  }
350	  for (const member of listing.stdout.split("\n").filter(Boolean)) {
351	    if (member === "." || member === "./" || member.startsWith("./")) {
352	      throw new Error(
353	        `${name} contains './'-prefixed member ${member}; repack with explicit top-level names or the shell installer breaks`,
354	      );
355	    }
356	  }
357	}

359	function verifyHomebrew(localArgs = args) {
360	  const dir = required(localArgs.dir, "--dir");
361	  const checksums = parseChecksums(required(localArgs.checksums, "--checksums"));
362	  const formulae = releaseFiles(dir, { includeChecksums: true, includeManifest: false })
363	    .filter((entry) => entry.name.endsWith(".rb"))
364	    .map((entry) => entry.relative);
365	  const findChecksum = (basename) =>
366	    checksums.get(basename) ??
367	    [...checksums.entries()].find(([name]) => path.basename(name) === basename)?.[1];
368	  let verifiedUrls = 0;
369	  for (const formula of formulae) {
370	    const text = fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, formula), "utf8");
371	    // Multi-platform formulae carry one url per target inside on_macos/on_linux
372	    // blocks, and cargo-dist only embeds sha256 lines at publish/host time. So
373	    // at the build+trust stage verify every referenced artifact is present in
374	    // SHA256SUMS (the integrity source of truth), and match any embedded sha256
375	    // we do find rather than requiring them.
376	    const urls = [...text.matchAll(/url\s+"([^"]+)"/g)].map((match) => match[1]);
377	    const embeddedShas = [...text.matchAll(/sha256\s+"([0-9a-fA-F]{64})"/g)].map((match) => match[1]);
378	    if (urls.length === 0) {
379	      throw new Error(`${formula} must reference at least one url`);
380	    }
381	    for (const url of urls) {
382	      const basename = path.basename(url);
383	      if (!findChecksum(basename)) {
384	        throw new Error(`${formula} references ${basename}, which is missing from SHA256SUMS`);
385	      }
386	      verifiedUrls += 1;
387	    }
388	    const knownChecksums = new Set(checksums.values());
389	    for (const sha of embeddedShas) {
390	      if (!knownChecksums.has(sha)) {
391	        throw new Error(`${formula} embeds sha256 ${sha}, which is not present in SHA256SUMS`);
392	      }
393	    }
394	  }
395	  writeJson({ ok: true, formulae: formulae.length, verified_urls: verifiedUrls });
396	}

398	function artifactRecord(dir, entry, lane, trust) {
399	  const absolute = path.join(dir, entry.relative);
400	  const target = TARGETS.find((candidate) => entry.name.includes(candidate)) ?? null;
401	  const targetTrust = target ? trust.get(target) : null;
402	  return {
403	    name: entry.name,
404	    target,
405	    kind: artifactKind(entry.relative),
406	    sha256: sha256(absolute),
407	    bytes: fs.statSync(absolute).size,
408	    signed: Boolean(targetTrust?.signed),
409	    signature_kind: targetTrust?.signature_kind ?? null,
410	    notarized: Boolean(targetTrust?.notarized),
411	    attested: lane.requires_attestation,
412	    sbom: entry.name.endsWith(".spdx.json") ? entry.name : null,
413	  };
414	}

416	function artifactKind(file) {
417	  if (file === "SHA256SUMS" || file.endsWith("/SHA256SUMS")) return "checksums";
418	  if (file.endsWith(".spdx.json")) return "sbom";
419	  if (file.startsWith("trust/") || file.includes("/trust/")) return "trust-status";
420	  if (file.endsWith(".rb")) return "homebrew-formula";
421	  if (file.endsWith(".sh") || file.endsWith(".ps1")) return "installer";
422	  if (file.endsWith(".zip") || file.endsWith(".tar.xz") || file.endsWith(".tar.gz") || file.endsWith(".tgz")) {
423	    return "archive";
424	  }
425	  if (file.endsWith(".json")) return "metadata";
426	  return "artifact";
427	}
428	
429	function readTrustStatus(dir) {
430	  const result = new Map();
431	  const trustDir = path.join(dir, "trust");
432	  if (!fs.existsSync(trustDir)) {
433	    return result;
434	  }
435	  for (const file of fs.readdirSync(trustDir)) {
436	    if (!file.endsWith(".json")) {
437	      continue;
438	    }
439	    const value = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(trustDir, file), "utf8"));
440	    if (value.target) {
441	      result.set(value.target, value);
442	    }
443	  }
444	  return result;
445	}
446	
447	// The shapes the publish step uploads. Anything else under the artifact
448	// tree (extracted per-target directories, loose binaries, READMEs) is a
449	// build intermediate, not a release asset — listing those in SHA256SUMS or
450	// the manifest would reference files users can never download.
451	function isReleaseAsset(name, relative) {
452	  if (relative.startsWith("trust/") || relative.includes("/trust/")) {
453	    return name.endsWith(".json");
454	  }
455	  return (
456	    name.endsWith(".tar.xz") ||
457	    name.endsWith(".tar.gz") ||
458	    name.endsWith(".tgz") ||
459	    name.endsWith(".zip") ||
460	    name.endsWith(".sha256") ||
461	    name === "sha256.sum" ||
462	    name === "deadreckon-installer.sh" ||
463	    name === "deadreckon-installer.ps1" ||
464	    name.endsWith(".rb") ||
465	    name === "SHA256SUMS" ||
466	    name === "release-manifest.json" ||
467	    name === "release.spdx.json"
468	  );
469	}
470	
471	function releaseFiles(dir, options) {
472	  const entries = [];
473	  walk(dir, (file) => {
474	    const relative = path.relative(dir, file).replaceAll(path.sep, "/");
475	    if (relative === ".DS_Store" || relative.endsWith("/.DS_Store")) {
476	      return;
477	    }
478	    const name = relative.split("/").pop();
479	    if (!isReleaseAsset(name, relative)) {
480	      return;
481	    }
482	    if (!options.includeChecksums && name === "SHA256SUMS") {
483	      return;
484	    }
485	    if (!options.includeManifest && name === "release-manifest.json") {
486	      return;
487	    }
488	    entries.push({ name, relative });
489	  });
490	  entries.sort((a, b) => a.relative.localeCompare(b.relative));
491	  // Published release assets are flat, so every artifact is recorded by its
492	  // basename — users verify downloads with `shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS`
493	  // next to flat files. The CI global-artifact layout nests some files
494	  // twice; identical duplicates collapse, divergent content fails closed.
495	  const byName = new Map();
496	  for (const entry of entries) {
497	    const existing = byName.get(entry.name);
498	    if (existing === undefined) {
499	      byName.set(entry.name, entry);
500	      continue;
501	    }
502	    const existingDigest = sha256(path.join(dir, existing.relative));
503	    const duplicateDigest = sha256(path.join(dir, entry.relative));
504	    if (existingDigest !== duplicateDigest) {
505	      throw new Error(
506	        `conflicting contents for release asset ${entry.name}: ${existing.relative} vs ${entry.relative}`,
507	      );
508	    }
509	  }
510	  return [...byName.values()].sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
511	}
512	
513	function walk(dir, visitor) {
514	  if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) {
515	    return;
516	  }
517	  for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
518	    const fullPath = path.join(dir, entry.name);
519	    if (entry.isDirectory()) {
520	      walk(fullPath, visitor);
521	    } else {
522	      visitor(fullPath);
523	    }
524	  }
525	}
526	
527	function parseChecksums(file) {
528	  const result = new Map();
529	  for (const line of fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8").split(/\r?\n/)) {
530	    if (!line.trim()) {
531	      continue;
532	    }
533	    const match = /^([a-f0-9]{64})\s+(.+)$/.exec(line.trim());
534	    if (!match) {
535	      throw new Error(`invalid SHA256SUMS line: ${line}`);
536	    }
537	    result.set(match[2], match[1]);
538	  }
539	  return result;
540	}
541	
542	function cargoMetadata() {
543	  const output = spawnSync("cargo", ["metadata", "--format-version=1", "--locked"], {
544	    encoding: "utf8",
545	  });
546	  if (output.status === 0) {
547	    return JSON.parse(output.stdout);
548	  }
549	  return {
550	    packages: [
551	      {
552	        name: "deadreckon",
553	        version: workspaceVersion(),
554	        source: null,
555	        license: "MIT",
556	      },
557	    ],
558	  };
559	}
560	
561	function workspaceVersion() {
562	  const text = fs.readFileSync("Cargo.toml", "utf8");
563	  const match = /\[workspace\.package\][\s\S]*?\nversion\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"/.exec(text);
564	  if (!match) {
565	    throw new Error("Cargo.toml [workspace.package] version not found");
566	  }
567	  return match[1];
568	}
569	
570	function wrapperPackageVersion() {
571	  const packageJson = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("npm/deadreckon/package.json", "utf8"));
572	  return packageJson.version;
573	}
574	
575	function changelogHasVersion(version, changelogPath) {
576	  if (!fs.existsSync(changelogPath)) {
577	    return false;
578	  }
579	  const escaped = version.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");
580	  return new RegExp(`^##\\s+.*\\b${escaped}\\b`, "m").test(fs.readFileSync(changelogPath, "utf8"));
581	}
582	
583	function safeId(value) {
584	  return value.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9.-]/g, "-");
585	}
586	
587	function sha256(file) {
588	  return crypto.createHash("sha256").update(fs.readFileSync(file)).digest("hex");
589	}
590	
591	function required(value, name) {
592	  if (!value) {
593	    throw new Error(`${name} is required`);
594	  }
595	  return value;
596	}
597	
598	function truthy(value) {
599	  return value === "1" || value === "true" || value === "TRUE" || value === "yes";
600	}
601	
602	function writeJson(value) {
603	  const text = `${JSON.stringify(value, null, 2)}\n`;
604	  if (args.out) {
605	    fs.writeFileSync(args.out, text);
606	  }
607	  if (args["github-output"]) {
608	    const lines = Object.entries(value)
609	      .filter(([, entry]) => entry === null || ["string", "number", "boolean"].includes(typeof entry))
610	      .map(([key, entry]) => `${key}=${entry ?? ""}`);
611	    fs.appendFileSync(args["github-output"], `${lines.join("\n")}\n`);
612	  }
613	  process.stdout.write(text);
614	}

583	    let distrib = temp.path().join("target/distrib");
584	    fs::create_dir_all(&distrib).expect("distrib dir");
585	    // Real archives: verify-manifest fails closed on unreadable or
586	    // "./"-prefixed archives, so placeholder bytes are not valid fixtures.
587	    for stem in [

595	            .args([
596	                "-cJf",
597	                distrib
598	                    .join(format!("{stem}.tar.xz"))
599	                    .to_str()
600	                    .expect("utf8 path"),
601	                "-C",
602	                temp.path().join("payload").to_str().expect("utf8 path"),
603	                stem,
604	            ])
605	            .output()
606	            .expect("tar");
607	        assert!(
608	            output.status.success(),
609	            "{}",
610	            String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr)
611	        );
612	    }
613	    fs::create_dir_all(distrib.join("trust")).expect("trust dir");
614	    fs::write(
615	        distrib.join("trust/macos-aarch64-apple-darwin.json"),
616	        r#"{"target":"aarch64-apple-darwin","signed":true,"notarized":true}"#,
617	    )
618	    .expect("mac trust");
619	
620	    assert_release_trust_success([
621	        "sbom",
622	        "--dir",
623	        distrib.to_str().expect("utf8 path"),
624	        "--out",
625	        distrib
626	            .join("release.spdx.json")
627	            .to_str()
628	            .expect("utf8 path"),
629	    ]);
630	    assert_release_trust_success([
631	        "checksums",
632	        "--dir",
633	        distrib.to_str().expect("utf8 path"),
634	        "--out",
635	        distrib.join("SHA256SUMS").to_str().expect("utf8 path"),
636	    ]);
637	    assert_release_trust_success([
638	        "manifest",
639	        "--dir",
640	        distrib.to_str().expect("utf8 path"),
641	        "--ref",
642	        "refs/tags/v1.2.3-rc.1",
643	        "--repo",
644	        "gregce/deadreckon",
645	        "--commit",
646	        "abc123",
647	        "--out",
648	        distrib
649	            .join("release-manifest.json")
650	            .to_str()
651	            .expect("utf8 path"),
652	    ]);
653	    assert_release_trust_success([
654	        "verify-manifest",
655	        "--dir",
656	        distrib.to_str().expect("utf8 path"),
657	        "--manifest",
658	        distrib
659	            .join("release-manifest.json")
660	            .to_str()
661	            .expect("utf8 path"),
662	        "--checksums",
663	        distrib.join("SHA256SUMS").to_str().expect("utf8 path"),
664	    ]);
665	
666	    let manifest = read_json(&distrib.join("release-manifest.json"));
667	    assert_eq!(
668	        Some(1),
669	        manifest.get("schema_version").and_then(JsonValue::as_u64)
670	    );
671	    assert_eq!(Some("rc"), manifest.get("lane").and_then(JsonValue::as_str));
672	    let artifacts = manifest
673	        .get("artifacts")
674	        .and_then(JsonValue::as_array)
675	        .expect("artifacts array");
676	    assert!(
677	        artifacts
678	            .iter()
679	            .any(|artifact| artifact.get("name").and_then(JsonValue::as_str)
680	                == Some("deadreckon-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.xz")
681	                && artifact.get("signed").and_then(JsonValue::as_bool) == Some(true)
682	                && artifact.get("notarized").and_then(JsonValue::as_bool) == Some(true)),
683	        "{manifest:#?}"
684	    );
685	    assert!(
686	        artifacts
687	            .iter()
688	            .any(|artifact| artifact.get("name").and_then(JsonValue::as_str) == Some("SHA256SUMS")),
689	        "{manifest:#?}"
690	    );
691	    assert!(
692	        artifacts
693	            .iter()
694	            .any(|artifact| artifact.get("name").and_then(JsonValue::as_str)
695	                == Some("release.spdx.json")),
696	        "{manifest:#?}"
697	    );
698	}

976	#[test]
977	fn checksums_record_flat_basenames_and_collapse_nested_duplicates() {
978	    let temp = tempfile::TempDir::new().expect("tempdir");
979	    let distrib = temp.path().join("target/distrib");
980	    fs::create_dir_all(distrib.join("target/distrib")).expect("nested dir");
981	    fs::write(distrib.join("deadreckon-installer.sh"), b"#!/bin/sh\n").expect("installer");
982	    // Build intermediates (extracted per-target dirs with loose binaries)
983	    // are not published assets and must never appear in SHA256SUMS — their
984	    // basenames collide across targets with different content.
985	    let loose = distrib.join("deadreckon-aarch64-apple-darwin");
986	    fs::create_dir_all(&loose).expect("loose dir");
987	    fs::write(loose.join("deadreckon"), b"mac binary").expect("loose binary");
988	    // The CI global-artifact layout nests some files twice with identical
989	    // content; SHA256SUMS must record one flat basename per asset so users
990	    // can run `shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS` next to downloaded files.
991	    fs::write(
992	        distrib.join("target/distrib/deadreckon-installer.sh"),
993	        b"#!/bin/sh\n",
994	    )
995	    .expect("nested duplicate");
996	    let sums = distrib.join("SHA256SUMS");
997	
998	    assert_release_trust_success([
999	        "checksums",
1000	        "--dir",
1001	        distrib.to_str().expect("utf8 path"),
1002	        "--out",
1003	        sums.to_str().expect("utf8 path"),
1004	    ]);
1005	
1006	    let raw = fs::read_to_string(&sums).expect("sums");
1007	    assert_eq!(raw.lines().count(), 1, "{raw}");
1008	    let line = raw.lines().next().expect("entry");
1009	    assert!(
1010	        line.ends_with("  deadreckon-installer.sh"),
1011	        "entry must be a flat basename: {line}"
1012	    );
1013	    assert!(
1014	        !line.contains('/'),
1015	        "no path segments in SHA256SUMS: {line}"
1016	    );
1017	}
